topic: Day 32 — carousel — Humility is thinking about yourself less, not thinking less of yourself

slides.text: It's thinking about yourself less, period.
The marker is reduced self-focus, not reduced self-worth.
Confusing the two misidentifies the actual trait.

caption:
True humility isn't self-deprecation. It's the freedom of not needing every situation to be about your own status or image.

Follow for one of these a day.
